name: Polymarket positioning risk-flip (prediction-market odds lead crypto risk)
rationale: Prediction-market odds on macro/risk events reprice the risk regime before it shows in any single asset's own price. When the cross-market risk-on probability (pm_implied_prob / pm_risk_on, the CLOB midpoint) is rising and above a fitted floor, ride crypto momentum; when the odds flip down (risk-off repricing) stand aside. Disconfirmer: exit when pm_implied_prob crosses back down through the exit level. NOTE: DATA-BLOCKED — the Polymarket CLOB exposes only LIVE order-book snapshots, not a positioning history endpoint; the PIT store currently holds only 4-5 snapshot rows (span < 1 day), so this spec CANNOT be gated yet. It is queued: it begins to fire once a continuous CLOB snapshot backfill (ingest tick) has accumulated real positioning history. The deterministic Gate (deflated Sharpe / PBO / holdout / FDR) judges it then — never the money path until it passes.
catalyst: rising cross-market risk-on odds while crypto momentum is positive
